method: Trusted player click; bounded current video descriptors or same-origin authenticated Web/HLS request inside Chrome. Only standard media URLs/duration/format data cross native IPC. No native cookie import, cookie API permission, session export, challenge solving or identity/client retry loop.
native: Bounded validated descriptors, ASCII JSON helper stdin, UTF-8 output, checked formats and 10 MiB HTTP chunks, encrypted resumable context, audio/video plus expected-duration verification.
installer: Recognized legacy HKCU host and matching user Desktop shortcut migrate with backups and ownership-aware uninstall restoration; Program Files/common Desktop/HKLM setup retained.

setup.limitations: Local Windows development machine, not a clean VM or signed release. Chrome text instructions verified without launching/changing normal Chrome; unpublished extension still requires Load unpacked. Fresh upstream downloads are not established when verifiedArchiveCacheSeeded is true. Production requires administrator approval and defaults to Program Files. Install/reinstall/uninstall ran on a private asInvoker build compiled from the same NSIS source/payload with all integration redirected; no actual elevated machine-wide installation was run.

portable.scope: ZIP integrity; app-local runtime; version; idempotent per-user setup; host origin/path; shortcut; actual GUI startup without developer PATH; uninstall restores previous registration/shortcut and preserves later ownership
portable.limitations: same development machine with sanitized PATH, not a clean Windows VM; optional media helpers separately verified by source media tests

browser.scope: Controlled YouTube origin in real private headless Chrome; trusted overlay click, MAIN/isolated worlds, same-origin browser session request, bounded native packet. Native transfer verified separately.

initialFailuresResolved: Combined real-helper fixture exceeded its prior 180-second whole-suite budget; 90-second individual GUI waits retained, 300-second driver and 360-second fixture budget used.
UTF-8 fixture output draining now reports thread errors rather than allowing a Windows cp1252 Unicode logging error.
Private browser native-response stub corrected to include protocol version 1; required torrent acceptance driver supplied to final portable checks.
limitations: Controlled actual Chrome origin/session-signature fixtures and full real local media transfers verified; no successful live signed-in public YouTube transfer, clean VM, remote CI or signed release is claimed. Setup tools checked from pinned cached upstream archives, not newly downloaded during final acceptance.
